gen-gf-dynapuff-poppins: Poppins reads smooth and sturdy, its curves running loose without a single flick of thick and thin. DynaPuff on top is the louder half, bubbly and pen-drawn, and that playful, puffed-up heading is what makes the pair memorable.
gen-gf-dynapuff-roboto-slab: Roboto Slab sets down a dense, structured line where the middle of each letter does most of the talking. And DynaPuff's marker-nib heading sits above it, so a long stretch of text would feel orderly, with the slab-serif body keeping everything grounded.
gen-gf-dynapuff-rubik: Rubik reads soft and round, with big-looking lowercase that stays clear even when small. Rubik also keeps going comfortably paragraph after paragraph, while DynaPuff's heading stays chunky and free of any swelling mid-curve.
gen-gf-economica-fs-literata: Contemporary and tightly packed, Economica makes each word look like a solid block with no stroke contrast at all. Literata does the opposite job, adding a faint swell in every curve so the text serif body feels bookish and warm.
gen-gf-el-messiri-fs-literata: El Messiri leads with a modern, clean heading whose curves stop short instead of closing up. And Literata follows in the serif body, with sturdy thin lines and slightly heavier thick ones that would make a long read feel bookish and unhurried.
gen-gf-electrolize-fs-literata: Literata brings a bookish, sophisticated body, its g built from lightly thinned links and sturdy bowls. Literata is the quiet one here, while Electrolize, drawn like a broad-nibbed pen that never curls shut, earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-elms-sans-fs-literata: Soft, rounded and unfussy, Elms Sans hums along with tails and terminals as thick as its stems. But Literata's text serif adds modest thick-thin contrast, and that gentle difference in texture is what gives the pair its edge.
gen-gf-encode-sans-fs-literata: Encode Sans has a friendly, open-jawed c that looks like a pair of pliers, set against Literata's sturdy and bookish letters. Literata keeps a serif body moving smoothly, its mid-range contrast never tiring.
gen-gf-encode-sans-expanded-fs-literata: A wide funnel of a throat in the e gives Encode Sans Expanded its stamp, with almost no stroke contrast. Literata adds a soft contrast that never looks flat or stark, so the two sit together like a crisp sketch beside a bookish page.
gen-gf-encode-sans-sc-fs-literata: Encode Sans SC keeps the ends of its c from ever turning inward, giving a neutral, modern look with no stroke contrast. But Literata's text serif body adds a smooth, modest weight gradient, and the heading earns its keep when big and short.
